Edge.description: After ``src`` finishes with outcome ``on``, ``dst`` runs next.

dst.description: The id of the node that runs next
dst.title: Dst

on.description: The outcome of src that takes this edge. Every non-terminal node has one success edge and one failure edge
on.title: On

src.description: The id of the node this edge leaves
src.title: Src

Edge.title: Edge

id.description: Unique node id: a letter, then letters, digits, '_' or '-', at most 64 characters
id.title: Id

max_retries.description: In-place retries: a failed node runs again up to this many times before its failure edge is taken. Overrides the graph's max_retries
max_retries.title: Max Retries

max_visits.description: Loop bound: a node visited more than max_visits times fails without running and takes its failure edge. A loop through edges ends only at a node with max_visits whose failure edge leaves the loop
max_visits.title: Max Visits

params.description: The skill's params. Each value is a literal or {"ref": "<node_id>.<field>"}, an output of a node that succeeds on every path to this one, or {"ref": "task.<param>"}
params.title: Params

skill.description: The name of a skill in the catalog
skill.title: Skill

timeout_s.description: Seconds the node may run before it fails
timeout_s.title: Timeout S

description:
A robot task program: skill calls joined by success and failure edges, run from ``entry`` until a
done or abort node. A node visited more than its max_visits fails without running and takes its failure
edge; a node's outputs can be read only by nodes that run after it has succeeded.

edges.description: One success edge and one failure edge per non-terminal node
edges.title: Edges

entry.description: The id of the first node to run
entry.title: Entry

max_retries.description: Default in-place retries for every node (a node's own max_retries overrides it). null means 1
max_retries.title: Max Retries

terminal_nodes.description: The ids of the done and abort nodes. A terminal node ends the program and has no edges
terminal_nodes.title: Terminal Nodes

title: ProgramGraph
